report_name: UMBRA Ransomware Group Targets Windows with Double Extortion

threat_actors.name: UMBRA Group
threat_actors.description: A new ransomware-as-a-service (RaaS) group that operates the UMBRA ransomware, employing double-extortion tactics against Windows systems.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
attack_patterns.description: The UMBRA Group exfiltrates valuable data from the victim's network before deploying the ransomware, using this data as leverage in their double-extortion strategy.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The UMBRA ransomware encrypts files across the victim's network to cause maximum operational disruption.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: The UMBRA ransomware operation likely deletes volume shadow copies using tools like wmic to prevent easy restoration of encrypted files.

attack_patterns.name: File and Directory Discovery
attack_patterns.description: The UMBRA ransomware systematically searches for files on infected Windows systems to encrypt them.

malware.name: UMBRA Ransomware
malware.description: A file-encrypting ransomware that targets Windows systems, appends the '.umbra' extension to encrypted files, and drops a ransom note named 'README_[victim_ID].txt'. It is used in double-extortion attacks.

tools.name: wmic
tools.description: Used to delete volume shadow copies to inhibit system recovery, as suggested by hunting hints for the UMBRA ransomware.

identities.name: Windows
identities.description: The target operating system for the UMBRA ransomware.

infrastructure.name: UMBRA TOR Communication Site
infrastructure.description: A TOR-based site used by the UMBRA Group for victims to negotiate ransom payments.

indicators.name: UMBRA Ransomware File Encryption
indicators.pattern:
title: UMBRA Ransomware File Encryption
id: 2b8c1a9f-5d7e-4f6a-8b3c-9d0e1f2a3b4c
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of files with the .umbra extension, which is indicative of an UMBRA ransomware infection.
references:
  - https://www.cyfirma.com/news/weekly-intelligence-report-11-sep-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-11
tags:
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.impact
level: critical
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.umbra'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects files being encrypted by UMBRA ransomware, identified by the '.umbra' file extension.

indicators.name: UMBRA Ransomware Ransom Note Creation
indicators.pattern:
title: UMBRA Ransomware Ransom Note Creation
id: 8e1f2a3b-4c5d-4e6f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of ransom notes named 'README_*.txt' associated with UMBRA ransomware.
references:
  - https://www.cyfirma.com/news/weekly-intelligence-report-11-sep-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-11
tags:
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|startswith: 'README_'
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.txt'
  condition: all of selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of the UMBRA ransom note, which follows the pattern 'README_[victim_ID].txt'.

indicators.name: Shadow Copy Deletion via WMIC
indicators.pattern:
title: Shadow Copy Deletion via WMIC
id: 5d6e7f8a-9b0c-4d1e-8f2a-3b4c5d6e7f8a
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of wmic.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common ransomware technique to inhibit system recovery.
references:
  - https://www.cyfirma.com/news/weekly-intelligence-report-11-sep-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-11
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\wmic.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'shadowcopy'
      - 'delete'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects attempts to delete volume shadow copies using wmic.exe, a behavior associated with ransomware like UMBRA to inhibit system recovery.
